description: Land Acquisition - Winchfieldpark Watta, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District and amendment to the Gazette Ex. No. 2019/47, Rambukkana D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a notice for acquiring a specific land parcel ("Winchfield Park watta") for public purpose (conservation of Knuckles range), describes the land details, lists claimants, and provides procedural information for compensation claims. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
